cell_type.evidence: In a previous study, we described the biochemical properties of a newly synthesized group of imidazopyrazole compounds. In this paper, to improve our knowledge on the pharmacological properties of these chemical compounds, we carry out a differential proteomic analysis on a hu-man melanoma cell line treated with one of these imidazopyrazole derivatives.
